title: In which country outside Iran, if any, will US forces strike Iran-aligned armed groups between July 22 and July 29, 2026?
background: Iran-aligned armed groups operate across several Middle Eastern countries, creating potential flashpoints for military confrontation with the United States.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera, supported where available by official military statements. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the country outside Iran where US forces conduct strikes against Iran-aligned armed groups between July 22 and July 29, 2026, inclusive. Direct US participation in either unilateral or joint strikes qualifies; threats, proposed operations, and diplomatic support do not. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's name, or “None” if no qualifying strikes occur.
